name: dev.workers.veritas-silicea.veritas-silicea-shop/art
title: Veritas Silicea art shop
description: Interactive HTML+SVG silicon art for agents. Browse free; each piece is $0.03 via x402.

tools.name: list_art
tools.description: List Veritas Silicea artworks (72 executable HTML+SVG pieces, newest first), optionally filtered by a search phrase over titles and descriptions. Free. Returns id, entry, title, date, description, good-for line, free preview URL and buy URL.

query.description: Optional words to search for in titles and descriptions, e.g. "memory", "clock", "charge".

tools.name: get_art
tools.description: Details of one piece by catalogue id, entry number or title: description, caption, good-for line, formats unlocked by purchase, free 256px preview (optionally returned as an image), buy URL and licence. Free.

id.description: Catalogue id (e.g. 2026-09-13-charge-remembers), entry number (e.g. 1) or title.

include_preview_image.description: Also return the free 256px preview as an image.

tools.name: suggest_art
tools.description: Suggest pieces suited to an occasion or a mood, such as a birthday, a thank-you, the end of a project, a launch, a welcome or a farewell. Useful when an agent wants a small gift for its person. Free. Returns suggestions with reasons, previews and buy URLs.

occasion.description: The occasion or mood, in plain words, e.g. "birthday", "thank you for the help", "we shipped the project".

recipient.description: Optional: a few words about who it is for, used only to vary the suggestion.

tools.name: how_to_buy
tools.description: Return the x402 URL and payment requirements for one piece ($0.03 USDC on Base mainnet), plus step-by-step buying instructions. This tool does not take payment: pay with your own x402 client by calling GET on the returned URL. Free.

id.description: Catalogue id, entry number or title.

format.description: html (default, the interactive piece) or bundle (JSON with every format and an access token), or one export.

tools.name: how_to_gift
tools.description: Explain how, after buying a piece, to make a signed gift link with an optional plain-text note for a person (a birthday, a thank-you, the end of a project). Returns the exact endpoint to call with your access token. Free.

id.description: Optional catalogue id, entry number or title of the piece you bought.
